Notes confirmed by 3 sources (FilledWithBarakah, Parfumo, ScentVerdict), all tiers agree; trademarked accords (Pamplezest, Oceanol, Ambernat, Ambertonic) shown as grapefruit, sea notes and amber; Cristalfizz left out. 75ml EDP and unisex confirmed by Superdrug (EAN page) and ScentVerdict. Awaiting photos.
Street Origins It's Giving New York Extrait de Parfum 75ml

Notes confirmed by 4 sources (Zaoud, FilledWithBarakah, ScentVerdict, Parfumo), all tiers agree; heart rose in 3 sources; brown sugar left out of the description for brevity (3 sources). Extrait 75ml confirmed by Superdrug (EAN page), Zaoud, FWB, ScentVerdict. Mostly sold as unisex (Zaoud lists it under men); supplier's Unisex used. Supplier sheet lists the concentration as Eau de Parfum, but the supplier name, Superdrug (EAN page) and the other retailers all say Extrait de Parfum, so Extrait used. Awaiting photos.
